data.name: 戈隆巨人
data.text:
本随从的法力值消耗会随你使用的上一张牌的法力值消耗而
降低。
data.text_en:
[x]This minion's Cost is
reduced by the Cost of the
last card you played.

policy: Original last personally paid hand root, across turns and all hand card types. Use the accepted numeric Cost from PlayRecord, regardless of payment account; no current-zone or printed-cost requery. Includes committed/countered/waiting roots using the existing physical-play policy. Precise CN basis remains uncalibrated.

official_sources.scope: Official 35.4 identifies a repeated-recalculation bug on Freezing Trap returns. It does not establish printed-versus-accepted basis or exact CN timing. No trap/card combination implementation added.
